# Hanvi Events — Full Knowledge Base & Service Specifications

## Company Overview
Hanvi Events is an elite event management and experiential design studio headquartered in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. We transform milestones into unforgettable memories through high-end mandap architecture, bespoke destination wedding planning, immersive floral artistry, themed milestone birthdays, and prestigious corporate summits.

- **Website**: https://www.hanvievents.com
- **Locations Covered**: Kakinada, Rajahmundry, East Godavari, Konaseema, Samalkota, Pithapuram, Amalapuram, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India.
- **Phone Numbers**: +91 93902 46849, +91 93922 46849
- **Email**: info@hanvievents.com
- **Google Maps Location**: https://maps.google.com/?q=Hanvi+Events+Kakinada
- **Address**: D.No 70-1-19, Near RTA Office, Nagamalli Thota Junction, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh 533003

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Luxury Wedding Planning & Decor
- **Traditional Telugu Weddings**: Authentic Muhurtham setups, Pellikuthuru, Pellikoduku ceremonies, Vratham decor, and sacred fire altars.
- **Pre-Wedding & Post-Wedding Celebrations**: Vibrant Mehendi lounges, Bollywood Sangeet stage production, Haldi splash zones, Cocktail nights, and Grand Reception stages.
- **Mandap Architecture**: Handcrafted natural floral mandaps (Jasmine, Marigold, Imported Dutch Roses, Orchids), South Indian temple bell structures, gold-gilded pillars, water bodies, and modern LED ambient lighting.
- **Turnkey Management**: Guest hospitality, vendor curation, wedding photography coordination, VIP transit, and on-site event timeline management.

### 2. Themed Birthday Celebrations & Milestones
- **Cradle & Naming Ceremonies (Barasala)**: Elegant floral cradles, pastel balloon arches, and traditional bronze artifact setups.
- **1st Birthday Extravaganzas**: Custom 3D character backdrops (Jungle Safari, Space Odyssey, Princess Castle, Royal Prince), interactive gaming arenas, and dessert tables.
- **Half Saree & Dhoti Functions (Langa Voni)**: Heritage south Indian cultural decor, floral jewelry, photo booths, and thematic entry paths.

### 3. Corporate Galas & Brand Activations
- **Corporate Conferences & Summits**: Seamless audio-visual projection, truss staging, speaker podiums, and live-streaming facilities.
- **Brand Launches & Expo Booths**: Product unveilings, lighting choreography, media walls, and registration desks.
- **Annual Day Celebrations & Award Nights**: Themed employee galas, red carpet experiences, and celebrity artist entertainment.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Which regions does Hanvi Events serve?
A: We are headquartered in Kakinada and serve all of East Godavari, Rajahmundry, Konaseema, Samalkota, Pithapuram, Amalapuram, and extend across Andhra Pradesh including Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada.

### Q: How far in advance should we book an event?
A: For weddings and peak Muhurtham dates, we recommend booking 2 to 6 months in advance. For birthdays and intimate gatherings, 2 to 4 weeks notice is typical, though express arrangements are available subject to calendar availability.

### Q: Can Hanvi Events customize themes to specific budgets?
A: Yes. Every event package is customized around your aesthetic preferences, venue dimensions, floral selections, and target investment level.

### Q: Do you provide 3D stage renders and mockups before execution?
A: Yes, our design team prepares detailed 3D spatial models and moodboards so you can visualize the exact layout, lighting, and floral density before on-site fabrication begins.
